name: operations.automatic_tasks

list.description: Read native automatic-operation tasks within an explicit created-time scope.

parameters.name: from-time
parameters.description: Native GMT+8 created-time lower bound YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, without offset.

parameters.name: to-time
parameters.description: Native GMT+8 created-time upper bound YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, without offset; fewer than 31 elapsed days after from-time.

purpose: Inspect automatic-operation tasks without executing, confirming or editing them.

fields.name: gmtCreate
fields.meaning: Native creation time, shown in GMT+8 by the frontend; distinct from modification/end/capture time.

fields.name: lastModifiedTime
fields.meaning: Native modification time; may be later than the queried creation-time bounds.

fields.name: endTime
fields.meaning: Native task end time, retained independently from creation and modification times.

fields.name: decisionStatus
fields.meaning: Native decision stage status; not collapsed into operation/completion status.

fields.name: successfulDecisionAmount
fields.meaning: Native successful decision amount text, preserved without numeric conversion.

fields.name: successfulOperationAmount
fields.meaning: Native successful operation amount text, separate from decision amount.

fields.name: operationStrategyName
fields.meaning: Native operation strategy name; no lookup or strategy join is performed.

fields.name: subStrategyName
fields.meaning: Native sub-strategy name retained separately from the operation strategy name.

identity_description: Native string taskId identifies a returned automatic-operation task within the exact created-time scope.
limitations: Only POST JSON /riskActionTask/listQuery.json; fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. This is distinct from funding-demand queries.
Dates are required native GMT+8 wall clocks with second precision. No local-time conversion or machine-today default.
Standard offset List acquisition uses rowStart/pageSize and native data.totalCount. Unknown native fields, amounts, statuses, nesting and order are retained.
Inquiry only: no Get, per-task detail, execution, confirmation, edit, history or joined strategy records.
The frontend date picker rejects a truncated elapsed-day difference greater than 30; ordered second-precision bounds therefore must be fewer than 31 elapsed days apart.
Large scopes can exhaust the shared request or time budget; narrow created-time bounds. No automatic date partitioning or alternate endpoint.
Live inquiry does not publish. Only complete nonempty explicit refresh replaces the saved capture; empty/error/incomplete refresh preserves prior rows and capture time. No Duckdog import.
